question: As per the 2011 Census, which of the following is the least populated state in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sikkim**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Sikkim has a population of **6.11 Lakhs**.
 
• The Sikkim census of 2011 says the population of Sikkim is the **least in all of India**.
